resources.string: Nothing is filtered. You hear the original audio.
Mutes music. Keeps speech and other sounds.
Mutes music. Adjust background sounds below.
Mutes music and background. Keeps speech.
Press the power button to connect and start. First time? Sukut will guide you through pairing.
Catching up. Unfiltered audio stays muted.
Catching up. Original audio is playing briefly.
Uses Dolby, equalisers and Bluetooth processing. Best for wireless. Slightly slower.
Straight to your speaker or headphones. Fastest. Skips phone sound effects.
Both use the same AI processing and music filtering. Changing this choice briefly restarts audio.
Device effects or faster output. Same AI quality.
Least delay. May crackle when the phone is busy.
A split second ready. Smooth on most phones.
Most protection against crackles. Sound starts a bit later.
Sukut waits briefly before playing the cleaned sound. A longer wait helps prevent pauses, but makes sound arrive later.
Boost during processing. Peak protection prevents clipping. Default: 0 dB.
Use the media volume keys or open the volume panel.
Choose Higher Quality in Output quality to favor your device effects. Support varies by device. Processed audio remains stereo.
Open Sound in your device Settings.
All media apps, or one app. Switching briefly restarts processing.
Enjoy the internet. Without the music.
Use one method. Already have Sukut on your computer? USB is quicker.
Sukut returns here automatically when connected. Then continue setup.
Activate the audio worker to continue.
Choose device effects or faster output below. You can change this later on Home.
Choose a mode, then press Start. Your Quick Settings tile remembers it.
Some music may remain, depending on the content.
Sound cutting out or briefly changing? More buffering can smooth it out, but adds delay. Changing this setting restarts processing.

0.4
• A redesigned Home, Settings and setup with clear English and Arabic controls.
• Activate the audio worker on this phone or over USB: choose one method.
• Pairing notifications appear before Wireless debugging opens.
• Music Filter, Optimized and Strict modes; only the power button starts audio.
• Clear Off and Standby states, larger sliders and smoother page navigation.
• Three buffering choices and a Bluetooth-only effects notice.
• On-device processing, silence standby and release of unused memory after stopping.
• Tutorial video, privacy policy, support and the new gold icon.
Nothing is playing. Sukut rests to save battery and resumes the moment sound starts.
Enjoy the internet. Without the music.
